EXP_15_D.name: Dynamic Employment Search
EXP_15_D.summary: Seeker evaluated vacancies; 1 met reservation wage standards.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents filter out vacancies paying below reservation wage ($3.00 < $4.00 reservation)

EXP_15_F.name: Informal Labor and Temporary Work

hypotheses.hypothesis: Day labor increases money but depletes physical energy

EXP_15_G.name: Household Cost Distribution

EXP_15_H.name: Housing Affordability and Tenancy
EXP_15_H.summary: Tenant paid $3.00 rent; landlord received $3.00; total currency strictly conserved.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rent transfers directly from tenant to landlord with conservation of money

hypotheses.hypothesis: Persistent unpaid rent triggers eviction and placement in community shelter

EXP_15_J.name: Economic Recovery and Persistent Poverty

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unhoused agent earning day-labor cash recovers into informal rental housing

EXP_15_K.name: Leisure Under Different Income Conditions
EXP_15_K.summary: Low-income agent prefers free park stroll; affluent agent evaluates paid pupusería dining.
